# EduRev

> > EduRev is a comprehensive learning platform offering free and premium courses, mock tests, and study materials for entrance exams, competitive exams, and school curricula.

EduRev provides personalized exam preparation across multiple Indian and international exams including NEET, JEE, UPSC, CAT, CLAT, and CBSE/ICSE board exams. The platform combines video lectures, revision notes, practice tests, and previous year questions to help students prepare effectively.

## Key Topics

- NEET
- JEE Main/Advanced
- CBSE
- NCERT
- CUET
- Mock Tests
- Entrance Exams
- Competitive Exams
- Study Materials
- Video Lectures
- Revision Notes
- Practice Tests
- Free Courses
- Exam Preparation
- Student Dashboard
